fills.note: Feast interval
fills.tieReason: The Konungr Hall (康恩格礼堂) card in s_00215 reads '每隔 60 秒举办一次宴会，提供 10 食物' (a feast every 60 seconds giving 10 food). Its build time, 3分10秒, is a separate field (buildTimeSeconds). In this checklist the landmark field productionTimeSeconds holds that periodic production interval: the seed already lists Konungr Hall as productionTimeSeconds=60 with effectValue=10. So the frame confirms 60.

fills.name: Konungr Hall
fills.value: 每隔 60 秒举办一次宴会，提供 10 食物，且每座长屋额外提供 5 食物，并拥有一次性持盾女战士集结。持盾女战士最多可招募 1 名，每建造一座长屋可额外招募 1 名。

fills.quote: 日德兰骑士被击杀时可额外获得 20 黄金。
fills.note: +20 extra gold when a Jylland Knight is killed; also +5 fire armor via Danevirke
fills.tieReason: The Valdemar Castle tooltip in s_00716 says it grants the Danish Longwall tech, which gives palisades +5 fire armor, and that Jylland Knights give an extra 20 gold when killed. The +5 belongs to the granted tech, which the checklist lists as Danevirke with effectValue=5. The landmark's own effect value is the 20 gold, which matches the seeded Valdemar Castle effectValue=20.
